label: LoRA Lab: Portrait Realism
description: Realism LoRAs for people — the base-realism pair that fixes the plastic look, plus the dedicated skin-texture model (tagged 'texture' so a template can draw one of each). Trigger phrases are woven into the item text verbatim; data carries the exact filename, creator-stated strength and Civitai AIR urn. Tagged by base-model family.

items.name: ultrareal-flux
items.text: unmistakably photographic skin and light, the ordinary imperfection of a real camera file rather than a render

lora_info.name: UltraRealistic Lora Project (Flux v2)
lora_info.creator: Danrisi
lora_info.about: The reference Flux realism LoRA, pulling faces and light off the plastic-render default (creator runs 0.5-1.0, usually 0.7, at guidance 3.5); 83,915 model downloads and 3,748 thumbs-up, 65,798 on v2 alone.

items.name: phlux-flux
items.text: photoreal rendering with lifted, deliberately styled lighting and clean separation between subject and ground

lora_info.name: Phlux - Photorealism with style
lora_info.creator: evertonlisboad367
lora_info.about: Photorealism with an opinionated lighting and colour treatment, recommended at 0.5-1 weight; 12,045 downloads and 855 thumbs-up, and the partner Civitai's realism article pairs with Amateur Photography for texture plus lighting.

items.name: skin-texture-flux
items.text: skin texture style, realism, detailed, visible pores and fine facial down catching the light, natural sheen instead of wax

lora_info.name: Realistic Skin Texture style (F1D v2.5)
lora_info.creator: EauDeNoire
lora_info.about: A neutral texture tool that restores pores, fine hair and micro-relief to over-smoothed faces; the biggest skin-texture LoRA on Civitai at 179,700 model downloads and 7,404 thumbs-up, 42,891 on this Flux.1 D v2.5 version.
